hooks.command: $env:PATH = $env:PATH + ';C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI'; Set-Location 'c:\Desktop\Kyzer website'; $token = gh auth token; git remote set-url origin "https://kyzerroboticspvtltd:$token@github.com/kyzerroboticspvtltd/kyzer-website.git"; $status = git status --porcelain -- kyzer-robotics.html admin.html index.html; if ($status) { git add kyzer-robotics.html admin.html index.html; git commit -m 'auto: update site'; git push; $out = @{systemMessage='Deployed to GitHub Pages'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out } else { $out = @{systemMessage='No changes to deploy'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out }
